name: Out-of-bounds Write
shortDescription: Writing data past the end or before the start of the intended buffer.

name: Cross-site Scripting
shortDescription: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation.

name: SQL Injection
shortDescription: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command.

name: Use After Free
shortDescription: Referencing memory after it has been freed.

name: OS Command Injection
shortDescription: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command.

name: Improper Input Validation
shortDescription: The product does not validate or incorrectly validates input.

name: Out-of-bounds Read
shortDescription: Reading data past the end or before the start of the intended buffer.

name: Path Traversal
shortDescription: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory.

name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
shortDescription: The web application does not verify that a request was intentionally provided by the user.

name: Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type
shortDescription: The product allows upload of files that can be automatically processed within its environment.

name: Missing Authorization
shortDescription: The product does not perform an authorization check when a user accesses a resource.

name: NULL Pointer Dereference
shortDescription: Dereferencing a pointer expected to be valid but is NULL.

name: Improper Authentication
shortDescription: The product does not adequately prove a claimed identity.

name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
shortDescription: An arithmetic operation produces a result outside the range representable by the type.

name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
shortDescription: Deserializing untrusted data without sufficient verification.

name: Command Injection
shortDescription: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command.

name: Improper Restriction of Operations within Memory Buffer
shortDescription: Operations performed on a memory buffer outside its intended boundary.

name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
shortDescription: The product contains hard-coded credentials for authentication or verification.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
shortDescription: The server fetches a remote resource without validating the user-supplied URL.

name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
shortDescription: The product does not perform authentication for a function that requires it.

name: Race Condition
shortDescription: Concurrent execution using a shared resource with improper synchronization.

name: Improper Privilege Management
shortDescription: The product does not properly assign, modify, track, or check privileges.

name: Code Injection
shortDescription: Improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code.

name: Incorrect Authorization
shortDescription: An authorization check is performed but produces an incorrect result.

name: Incorrect Default Permissions
shortDescription: The product sets incorrect default permissions during installation or initialization.

name: Improper Neutralization in Data Query Logic
shortDescription: Untrusted input alters the intended structure of a data query, e.g. NoSQL injection.

name: XML External Entity Reference (XXE)
shortDescription: The product processes an XML document that can contain XML entities referencing resources outside the intended scope.

name: Prototype Pollution
shortDescription: Improperly controlled modification of object prototype attributes.

name: Exposure of Sensitive Information
shortDescription: Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor.

name: Sensitive Information in Error Message
shortDescription: Generation of an error message containing sensitive information.

name: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
shortDescription: The product does not verify, or incorrectly verifies, the cryptographic signature of data (e.g. a JWT).

name: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
shortDescription: The product does not sufficiently verify the origin or authenticity of data.

name: HTTP Request Smuggling
shortDescription: Inconsistent interpretation of malformed HTTP requests between intermediary and endpoint.
